Andhra Pradesh Faces Multiple Issues: Health, Agriculture, and Governance

Andhra Pradesh is experiencing a rise in COVID-19 cases, with the tally reaching 49, prompting alerts in areas like Jeypore. The state government is also considering a relief package for tobacco farmers facing problems, in conjunction with the central government. Meanwhile, the Chief Minister's new office is set to overlook the Bay of Bengal, and the state's Chief Electoral Officer assured that all eligible voters will be included in draft rolls. Separately, the state has mandated an audit for all C-section deliveries covered by its health insurance scheme.
